title: Mass Spectrometry Imaging of Invisible Micro-Patterns on Graphene Substrate
protocol: Prepare engineered graphene films by filtering solvent-dispersed graphene sheets at a concentration of 1 mg/mL.
Scan the selected area of the graphene film with a pulsed nitrogen laser at 337 nm and 200 Hz.
Set the spot-to-spot distance to 30 µm and take 500 shots per spot with a laser intensity of 50% (about 121.8 µJ for 100%).
Dilute analytes (DOTAP) solutions in a step-wise manner and store them at -20°C before use.
Dip the stamp into the diluted solution and press it onto the engineered graphene film to mark the pattern.
Set up matrix-free LDI MS imaging by setting the spot-to-spot distance to 50 µm and taking 50 laser shots with an intensity of 36% at each spot.
Apply a nitrogen laser (337 nm) at a repetition rate of 200 Hz for the imaging setup.
Acquire a full mass spectrum ranging from 200 to 2000 m/z for every pixel at an x-y step-size of 50 µm.
Store imaging data in the FlexImaging data format.
Execute 2D image construction using custom-made scripts in the FlexImaging software.
Perform peak finding for each pixel at specific m/z values of 380 and 662.
Integrate peaks using a 0.3 Da window.
